title: Ganeshana Maduve
desc: Ganesha lives happily in a complex owned by Ramanamurthy. Things take a turn when he falls in love with Adilakshmi, the youngest daughter of Ramanamurthy who sings under the pseudonym Shruti.

title: Jai Simha
desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.

title: Kurukshetra
desc: After losing to the Kauravas in a gamble, the Pandavas go into exile. Upon their return, conflict arises over the dynastic succession leading to a war.

title: Kantara: Chapter 1
desc: Berme discovers Princess Kanakavathi's dark alliance with an exiled magic-wielding tribe. Thus, in order to save the realm of Kantara, he unleashes the powerful Daivas on a mission.

title: Preethse
desc: Surya, a military commander, is soon to be engaged to Kiran, a college student. Unbeknownst to him, one of Kiran's classmates is also in love with her.
